questions.title: What if someone gives you golf tips without you asking?
questions.question: If another player tells you what club to use or where to aim before you hit your shot, but you did not ask them, what happens?

choices.text: Both of you get 2 penalty shots.

questions.explanation: You don’t get a penalty if someone gives you advice and you didn’t ask for it.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: Advice is when someone tells you how to play your shot, like what club to pick or where to hit your ball.

questions.teachingTip: Act out a situation where someone blurts out tips, and discuss what the rule says to help kids remember they won't get in trouble if they didn't ask for help.
likelyMisconceptions: Children may think they get a penalty any time someone talks to them about their shot.

questions.title: What happens if you get advice without asking?
questions.question: If another player gives you advice before your shot—but you didn't ask for it—what do the rules say happens?
questions.explanation: You do not get a penalty if another player gives you unsolicited advice.
